protocolNotes.order: Rotate codec order each round and reverse every second round; alternate encode/decode order. No explicit GC. All data read once into memory before any codec timings.
protocolNotes.encode: JSON.stringify original parsed state, UTF-8 encode, compression, SHA-256, envelope serialization; plain baseline JSON.stringify only. Omits SQLite write time.
protocolNotes.decode: Envelope parse/validation, bounded decompression, SHA-256, UTF-8 conversion, JSON.parse, SQL kind/id/session ownership validation; plain baseline JSON.parse. Omits SQLite read time.
protocolNotes.caveat: Small single-process codec microbenchmark on one nine-row OKX snapshot, not an isolated whole-application benchmark or real-run speed comparison. Concurrent work and garbage collection may influence timings. Payload savings exclude SQLite indexes/pages/WAL and evidence; no original database was changed.
protocolNotes.candidateEnvelope: Prototype format=entity version=1 kind=state codec=gzip|zstd bytes sha256, plus id and sessionId. Entire state remains inside one row. Product implementation/schema migration not changed.
